gap.description: The capability gap this hunt was for.

queries_run.description: Exact queries/commands run, so the search is reproducible.

what_it_does.description: One sentence, from its own README/SKILL.md, not guessed.

why_it_fits.description: Which part of the gap it covers. Say 'partial' and what's missing if partial.

concerns.description: Licence, staleness, stack mismatch, scripts/hooks/network calls seen, overlap. 'none seen' if none.

stars.description: From gh api, or null if not checked.

last_push.description: YYYY-MM-DD from gh api, or null.

install_or_use.description: Exact install command, or the file paths worth borrowing. Never run it.

notes.description: Anything the orchestrator should know: dead ends, better keywords, nothing-found.
